72template <typename T>
73tensorium::Tensor<T, 2>
74compute_dt_gamma_from_metric(const tensorium::Vector<T> &X, const tensorium_RG::Metric<T> &metric,
75 T dt) {
76 if (X.size() < 1)
77 throw std::invalid_argument("BSSN::compute_dt_gamma_from_metric requires a time coordinate");
78
79 auto sample_gamma = [&](T dt_shift) {
80 tensorium::Vector<T> Xt = X;
81 Xt(0) += dt_shift;
82 T alpha_tmp;
83 tensorium::Vector<T> beta_tmp(3);
84 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> gamma_tmp({3, 3});
85 metric.BSSN(Xt, alpha_tmp, beta_tmp, gamma_tmp);
86 return gamma_tmp;
87 };
88
89 auto gm2 = sample_gamma(-2 * dt);
90 auto gm1 = sample_gamma(-dt);
91 auto gp1 = sample_gamma(dt);
92 auto gp2 = sample_gamma(2 * dt);
93
94 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> result({3, 3});
95 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
96 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
97 result(i, j) = (-gp2(i, j) + 8 * gp1(i, j) - 8 * gm1(i, j) + gm2(i, j)) / (12 * dt);
98
99 return result;
100}

112template <typename T> class BSSN {
113 public:
114 BSSNGrid grid;
115
116 void init_BSSN(const tensorium::Vector<T> &X, const tensorium_RG::Metric<T> &metric, T dx, T dy,
117 T dz, T dt) {
118 T alpha;
119 tensorium::Vector<T> beta(3);
120 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> gamma_ij({3, 3});
121 metric.BSSN(X, alpha, beta, gamma_ij);
122
123 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> gamma_ij_inv = inv_mat_tensor(gamma_ij);
124 T chi = metric.compute_conformal_factor(gamma_ij);
125 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> gamma_tilde = compute_conformal_metric(metric, gamma_ij, chi);
126 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> gamma_tilde_inv = inv_mat_tensor(gamma_tilde);
127
128 auto dt_gamma = compute_dt_gamma_from_metric(X, metric, dt);
129
130 auto dgamma_tilde = autodiff(
131 X, dx, dy, dz,
132 [&](const tensorium::Vector<T> &Xs) {
133 T a_tmp;
134 tensorium::Vector<T> b_tmp(3);
135 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> g_tmp({3, 3});
136 metric.BSSN(Xs, a_tmp, b_tmp, g_tmp);
137 T chi_tmp = compute_conformal_factor(metric, g_tmp);
138 return compute_conformal_metric(metric, g_tmp, chi_tmp);
139 },
140 DiffMode::PARTIAL);
141
142 tensorium::Tensor<T, 3> christoffel_tilde({3, 3, 3});
143 compute_christoffel_3D(gamma_tilde, dgamma_tilde, gamma_tilde_inv, christoffel_tilde);
144
145 tensorium::Vector<T> tilde_Gamma(3);
146 TildeGamma<T>::compute(gamma_tilde_inv, christoffel_tilde, tilde_Gamma);
147
148 auto contracted_Gamma =
149 tensorium_RG::BSSNContractedGamma<T>::compute(X, metric, dx, dy, dz, chi);
150
151 auto d_beta_raw = autodiff(
152 X, dx, dy, dz,
153 [&](const tensorium::Vector<T> &Xs) {
154 T a_tmp;
155 tensorium::Vector<T> b_tmp(3);
156 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> g_tmp({3, 3});
157 metric.BSSN(Xs, a_tmp, b_tmp, g_tmp);
158 return b_tmp;
159 },
160 DiffMode::PARTIAL);
161
162 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> d_beta({3, 3}); // derivative direction, component
163 for (int comp = 0; comp < 3; ++comp)
164 for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
165 d_beta(axis, comp) = d_beta_raw(comp, axis);
166
167 auto dgamma_phys = autodiff(
168 X, dx, dy, dz,
169 [&](const tensorium::Vector<T> &Xs) {
170 T a_tmp;
171 tensorium::Vector<T> b_tmp(3);
172 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> g_tmp({3, 3});
173 metric.BSSN(Xs, a_tmp, b_tmp, g_tmp);
174 return g_tmp;
175 },
176 DiffMode::PARTIAL);
177
178 tensorium::Tensor<T, 3> christoffel_phys({3, 3, 3});
179 compute_christoffel_3D(gamma_ij, dgamma_phys, gamma_ij_inv, christoffel_phys);
180
181 tensorium::Vector<T> beta_cov(3);
182 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> partial_beta_cov({3, 3});
183 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
184 T sum = 0;
185 for (int m = 0; m < 3; ++m)
186 sum += gamma_ij(j, m) * beta(m);
187 beta_cov(j) = sum;
188 }
189
190 for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis)
191 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
192 T s = 0;
193 for (int m = 0; m < 3; ++m)
194 s += dgamma_phys(axis, j, m) * beta(m) + gamma_ij(j, m) * d_beta(axis, m);
195 partial_beta_cov(axis, j) = s;
196 }
197
198 tensorium_RG::ExtrinsicCurvature<T> extr;
199 auto Kij = extr.compute_Kij(dt_gamma, beta_cov, partial_beta_cov, christoffel_phys, alpha);
200 auto Lie = tensorium_RG::compute_dt_gamma_from_beta(beta_cov, partial_beta_cov, christoffel_phys);
201 print_tensor2("Lie_beta(gamma_ij)", Lie);
202
203 tensorium::Tensor<T, 2> resid({3, 3});
204 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
205 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
206 resid(i, j) = 2.0 * alpha * Kij(i, j) - Lie(i, j);
207
208 print_tensor2("Stationarity residual R_ij = 2α K_ij - Lie_beta(gamma_ij)", resid);
209
210 tensorium_RG::BSSNAtildeTensor<T> Aij;
211 auto AtildeTensor = Aij.compute_Atilde_tensor(Kij, gamma_ij_inv, gamma_ij, chi);
212
213 const size_t NX = 64, NY = 64, NZ = 64;
214
215 tensorium::Tensor<T, 5> Atilde_full({NX, NY, NZ, 3, 3});
216 tensorium::Tensor<T, 5> gtilde_inv_full({NX, NY, NZ, 3, 3});
217 for (size_t i = 0; i < NX; ++i) {
218 for (size_t j = 0; j < NY; ++j) {
219 for (size_t k = 0; k < NZ; ++k) {
220 for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {
221 for (int b = 0; b < 3; ++b) {
222 Atilde_full(std::array<size_t, 5>{i, j, k, (size_t)a, (size_t)b}) =
223 AtildeTensor(a, b);
224 gtilde_inv_full(std::array<size_t, 5>{i, j, k, (size_t)a, (size_t)b}) =
225 gamma_tilde_inv(a, b);
226 }
227 }
228 }
229 }
230 }
231
232 auto chi_ctx = ChiContext<T>::compute(X, dx, dy, dz, gamma_ij, dgamma_phys, metric);
233 auto Ricci_tilde = RicciTildeTensor<T>::compute_Ricci_Tilde_tensor(
234 chi_ctx, gamma_tilde_inv, tilde_Gamma, christoffel_tilde, gamma_tilde);
235
236 auto Ricci_chi = RicciConformalTensor<T>::compute_Ricci_chi_total(
237 chi_ctx, gamma_tilde, gamma_tilde_inv, christoffel_tilde);
238
239 auto Ricci = RicciPhysicalTensor<T>::compute_Ricci_total(
240 chi_ctx, gamma_tilde, gamma_tilde_inv, tilde_Gamma, christoffel_tilde);
241
242 grid.alpha = {alpha};
243 grid.beta = {beta};
244 grid.gamma_ij = {gamma_ij};
245 grid.gamma_ij_inv = {gamma_ij_inv};
246 grid.chi = {chi};
247 grid.gamma_tilde = {gamma_tilde};
248 grid.gamma_tilde_inv = {gamma_tilde_inv};
249 grid.dgamma_tilde = {dgamma_tilde};
250 grid.christoffel_tilde = {christoffel_tilde};
251 grid.tilde_Gamma = {tilde_Gamma};
252 grid.contracted_Gamma = {contracted_Gamma};
253 grid.ExtrinsicTensor = {Kij};
254 grid.A_tildeTensor = {AtildeTensor};
255
256 std::cout << std::setprecision(6) << std::fixed;
257 std::cout << "\n========= BSSN Quantities at X =========\n";
258
259 std::cout << "--- alpha ---\n" << grid.alpha[0] << "\n";
260 print_vector("beta", grid.beta[0]);
261
262 std::cout << "dbeta\n";
263 d_beta.print();
264
265 print_tensor2("gamma_ij", grid.gamma_ij[0]);
266 print_tensor2("gamma_ij_inv", grid.gamma_ij_inv[0]);
267
268 print_tensor2("gamma_tilde", grid.gamma_tilde[0]);
269 print_tensor2("gamma_tilde_inv", grid.gamma_tilde_inv[0]);
270
271 print_tensor3("dgamma_tilde", grid.dgamma_tilde[0]);
272 print_tensor3("christoffel_tilde", grid.christoffel_tilde[0]);
273 print_vector("tilde_Gamma", grid.tilde_Gamma[0]);
274
275 print_tensor2("∂_t gamma_ij (dgt)", dt_gamma);
276 print_vector("contracted_Gamma", grid.contracted_Gamma[0]);
277
278 print_tensor3("dgamma_phys", dgamma_phys);
279 print_tensor3("christoffel_phys", christoffel_phys);
280 print_tensor2("Extrinsic curvature K_ij", grid.ExtrinsicTensor[0]);
281 print_tensor2("A_tilde_ij", grid.A_tildeTensor[0]);
282 std::cout << "--- chi ---\n" << grid.chi[0] << "\n";
283
284 print_tensor2("Full Ricci R_ij", Ricci_tilde);
285 print_tensor2("Ricci chi total term", Ricci_chi);
286 print_tensor2("Ricci physical tensor", Ricci);
287
288 std::cout << "========================================\n\n";
289 }

291 void init_BSSN(const tensorium::Vector<T> &X, const tensorium_RG::Metric<T> &metric, T dx, T dy,
292 T dz) {
293 init_BSSN(X, metric, dx, dy, dz, dx);
294 }
295};
